question: What does Qnami do currently? Summarise it in 200 words
answer:
Here’s a concise 200‑word summary of what Qnami currently does:

Qnami is a Swiss quantum‑sensing company, founded in 2016–2017 and rooted in the University of Basel, that develops and commercializes advanced quantum sensing and microscopy systems based on nitrogen‑vacancy (NV) centers in diamond ([thequantuminsider.com](https://thequantuminsider.com/2021/05/12/swiss-based-qnami-closes-4-million-chf-4-4-million-u-s-series-a-funding-round/?utm_source=openai)). Its flagship product, the ProteusQ™, is the world’s first commercial scanning NV magnetometer, combining NV magnetometry with scanning probe microscopy to deliver nanoscale imaging of magnetic fields and surface topography with exceptional sensitivity and resolution ([eetimes.eu](https://www.eetimes.eu/swiss-quantum-sensing-startup-raises-e3-6m/?utm_source=openai)).

Qnami fabricates proprietary diamond-based “Quantilever” scanning probes and integrates them into the ProteusQ platform, enabling quantitative, non‑perturbative magnetic field measurements under ambient conditions ([eetimes.eu](https://www.eetimes.eu/swiss-quantum-sensing-startup-raises-e3-6m/?utm_source=openai)). The company also offers a low‑temperature variant, ProteusQ‑LT, expanding capabilities into cryogenic environments ([qnami.ch](https://qnami.ch/?utm_source=openai)).

Qnami has established global distribution partnerships—most notably with HORIBA for worldwide reach and with Quantum Design in Japan and South Korea—to broaden access to its quantum microscopy solutions ([horiba.com](https://www.horiba.com/int/scientific/resources/news/detail/news/7/2020/horiba-signs-strategic-cooperation-agreement-with-qnami-to-accelerate-scanning-nv-magnetometry-deve/?utm_source=openai)). Its instruments are deployed in over ten leading research institutions across Europe and North America, supporting cutting‑edge work in materials science, spintronics, life sciences, and quantum device development ([thequantuminsider.com](https://thequantuminsider.com/2024/02/02/qnami-expands-into-japan-and-south-korea/?utm_source=openai)).

In summary, Qnami currently leads in commercial quantum sensing by delivering high‑precision NV‑based microscopy tools, expanding into cryogenic applications, and scaling globally through strategic partnerships.
